issue.title: Add country lookup
issue.body:
## Story

As a voter, I want my country looked up from my phone number, so that I do not pick it from a list.

## Requirement ids

REQ-RULE-009

## Acceptance criteria

- Given a number starting +977, When it is entered, Then the country is Nepal.

## Out of scope

Carrier lookup.

## Definition of done

`pnpm test` green; the test cites REQ-RULE-009.
